walls.name: North pool west curved patio retaining wall
walls.trust: Curved white retaining frontage and the stair opening are visible in IMG_2204 and private photos/05. Polyline traced against the aerial pool and registry facades, with approximately 1–2 m placement uncertainty; wall thickness and height estimated, not surveyed. Ends stop at the visible west patio band and north passage; no unseen enclosure is completed.
